verdict.rationale: New Relic documents an autonomous vulnerability-management agent that triages CVEs, drafts remediations, and opens Jira/GitHub tickets on its own, plus messaging about moving 'beyond assistance to automated remediation,' showing genuine background-running agentic automation. However, this is narrow (vulnerability management specifically) rather than a general-purpose automation/workflow builder for AI-native users across the platform. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader, user-configurable automation/agent-builder framework spanning multiple domains (not just CVE remediation), and independent/hands-on confirmation the autonomous agent works reliably in production.
